_comment: Known defects inherited from upstream 2.2. Reported but not failing, so new violations are visible. This ledger only shrinks - remove entries as the referenced issues are fixed. Regenerate deliberately, never to silence a new failure. It is currently EMPTY, for the first time since it was written: the 22 item-curve rows were cleared by #373 and the 47 merge-value rows by #334, and nothing has replaced them. An empty ledger means every violation the validator can report is a new one, which is the state it was always meant to reach.
